function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a trusted non-interactive shell command in the workspace on macOS/Linux. Not an OS sandbox. Default limits: 120s, 1.5 GiB process-group RSS sampling, 1 MiB captured output. Overflow terminates the command and saves a bounded log; returned text is capped at 64 KiB.

run_in_background.description: Run asynchronously; immediately return a task ID. Completed results are delivered on a later round.
